description: Public Instagram profile from Instagram's web profile JSON: ID, username, full name, bio, external link and bio links, verified/private/business flags, category, exact follower, following and post counts, reel/highlight counts and profile picture. Anonymous access is throttled by Instagram, so a call can fail with 503 (not charged); a few business profiles hit an Instagram-side error (502). Unknown usernames return 404. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
